## Fender Blues Jr III

![Fender Blues Jr](posts/img/bluesjr.jpg)

The **Fender Blues Junior III** is a member of Fender's renowned **Hot
Rod** amplifier series, found on stages around the world. Known for its
unmistakable Fender tone, the Blues Junior III is a 15-watt all-tube
combo amplifier that serves as an excellent platform for pedals while
delivering warm clean tones and rich tube overdrive.

A longtime favourite for both stage and studio, it features EL84 power
tubes, 12AX7 preamp tubes, genuine spring reverb, a simple control
layout, a footswitchable **FAT** boost, and support for an external
speaker cabinet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Purchase Information

- **Date:** 2017-11-12
- **Store:** Best Buy, West Vancouver

------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Black control panel with front-reading text
- New Fender badge

- Sparkle circuit modification
- Rattle-reducing shock absorbers for the EL84 tubes
- Fender Special Design 12" *Lightning Bolt* speaker by Eminence
- Heavy-duty set-screw chicken-head knobs

## Gibson Les Paul

![Gibson Les Paul](posts/img/lespaul.png)

The **Les Paul Tribute** captures the historic character of the
legendary Les Paul guitar. Historic Gibson tonewoods, a carved top,
cream pickguard, vintage-style tuners, trapezoid inlays, and boosted
PAF-inspired pickups deliver classic Gibson looks and sound with an
elegant vintage touch. There is **no weight relief**, making it ideal
for players who appreciate the authentic feel of a traditional Les Paul.

[Source](http://legacy.gibson.com/Products/Electric-Guitars/2018/USA/Les-Paul-Tribute-2018.aspx).

## ZOOM Multi-FX Processor

![ZOOM Multi-FX Processor](posts/img/Zoom_G3Xn_Top.jpg){width="540"}

The **ZOOM G3Xn Multi-FX Processor** is a compact guitar effects unit
that combines high-quality digital effects, amplifier and cabinet
modeling, looping, rhythm accompaniment, and USB connectivity. It allows
guitarists to build complex signal chains while maintaining an intuitive
stompbox-style interface with dedicated displays and footswitches.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Purchase Information

- **Date:** 2018-12-27
- **Store:** Long & McQuade, Richmond

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Features

- 70 onboard effects
  - 68 guitar effects
  - 1 Looper
  - 1 Rhythm pedal
- High-quality effects including:
  - Distortion
  - Overdrive
  - Equalizer (EQ)
  - Compression
  - Delay
  - Reverb
  - Flanger
  - Phaser
  - Chorus
- 5 amplifier emulators
- 5 cabinet emulators
- 75 factory preset patches
- Free **ZOOM Guitar Lab** software for macOS and Windows
  - Download additional effects
  - Download and manage patches
- Up to **7 simultaneous effects**, chained in any order
- Three stompbox footswitches for instant effect on/off control
- Three independent editing displays
- Auto Save for automatic storage of edited patches

## Fender Jaguar

![Fender Jaguar](posts/img/jaguar_hh0.jpeg)

Respecting their heritage while offering a modern twist on a classic,
Fender's Player Series Jaguar updates the popular short-scale instrument
with modern features and pickups. Starting with the surf, indie rock and
punk favourite's iconic offset body and easy-playing 24" scale length,
Fender refines the design with freshly designed Player Series pickups,
for an exceptional range of available tones. The maple neck now boasts a
contemporary 9.5" radius pau ferro fingerboard, and the Adjusto-matic
bridge and anchored tailpiece offers stable tuning and rock-solid
intonation. Always a guitar for the musically adventurous, the Player
Series Jaguar is ready for you to create whatever music floats into your
head.

[Source](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/guitars/fender-player-jaguar-hh-pau-ferro-fingerboard-limited-edition-electric-guitar).

## Fender Telecaster

![Fender Telecaster](posts/img/tele_mij.png)

The **Made in Japan Traditional** series was derived by combining the
aesthetics of Fender's traditional musical instrument production with
sophisticated Japanese craftsmanship. The orthodox DNA of Fender is
revived with solid **Made in Japan** quality.

The **Made in Japan Traditional 60s Telecaster®** uses a basswood body
with a gloss finish. The 9.5-inch radius **"U"**-shaped maple neck,
equipped with 21 vintage-style frets, provides the classic playability
unique to the Traditional series. A vintage-style Tele® bridge with
three threaded steel saddles and the original pickups selected for the
Traditional series deliver an authentic, musical vintage tone. The
narrow nut width is designed for comfortable playability.

[Source](https://jp.fender.com/products/made-in-japan-traditional-60s-telecaster)

## JOYO JF-09 TREMOLO

![JOYO JF-09 TREMOLO](posts/img/JOYO.jpg){width="246"}

The **JOYO JF-09 Tremolo** recreates the classic tremolo effect found in
vintage tube amplifiers. It uses the same **photoelectric tube
circuitry** found in many classic amp designs, producing a warm, smooth,
and musical modulation. Simple **Intensity** and **Rate** controls make
it easy to dial in anything from a subtle shimmer to a deep pulsing
tremolo.

The pedal features **true bypass** switching to minimize tone loss when
disengaged and is housed in a durable aluminum alloy enclosure with a
stoving varnish finish.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Features

- Vintage tube amplifier-style tremolo
- Photoelectric tube circuit emulation
- Warm, smooth modulation
- Simple two-knob operation
- True bypass switching
- Rugged aluminum alloy enclosure
- Durable stoving varnish finish

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Overview

| Item             | Specification                        |
|------------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Model**        | JF-09                                |
| **Manufacturer** | JOYO                                 |
| **Effect Type**  | Tremolo                              |
| **Circuit**      | Photoelectric Tube Circuit Emulation |
| **Bypass**       | True Bypass                          |
| **Enclosure**    | Aluminum Alloy                       |
| **Finish**       | Stoving Varnish                      |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Controls

| Control       | Function                                    |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------|
| **Intensity** | Adjusts the depth of the tremolo effect     |
| **Rate**      | Adjusts the speed of the tremolo modulation |

## Blue Yeti

![Blue Yeti](posts/img/Yeti.jpg){fig-align="center" width="388"}

![](posts/img/Yeti_Diagram.jpg){fig-align="center" width="602"}

The **Blue Yeti** is a USB condenser microphone designed for podcasting,
streaming, voice-over work, music recording, and video production.
Featuring three proprietary condenser capsules and four selectable polar
patterns, it provides versatile recording options while offering
built-in headphone monitoring with zero-latency playback.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Features

- USB plug-and-play connectivity
- Three custom 14 mm condenser capsules
- Four selectable polar patterns
  - Cardioid
  - Bidirectional

32GB unified memory

512GB SSD

HDMI display video output

On front (M1 Max):
